name: singlet_spatial_domains_cell_niche_identification
title: Identify cellular niches from spatial neighbourhoods
description: Assigns each cell to a recurring multicellular niche from the labels or embeddings of its spatial neighbours at one or more scales. Methods: composition (default; neighbour-label profiles clustered with Leiden, with enrichment) and cellcharter (multi-hop ring features with a full-covariance Gaussian mixture and soft memberships). Needs obsm/spatial, a cell-type label for composition, and a normalised layer or use_rep for cellcharter; writes obs/niche_label and related members. Do NOT use it to assign cell types, to match niches across sections, or to claim that niches add information beyond labels without a non-spatial baseline.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: composition: neighbour-label profiles and Leiden (published standard, default). cellcharter: ring features and Gaussian mixture with soft memberships.

graph.description: Spatial graph and neighbourhood size shared by all methods.

graph_type.description: knn: k nearest neighbours; delaunay: triangulation of the coordinates.

n_neighbors.description: Neighbours k for the spatial graph and the Leiden kNN; 15 is the squidpy default.

resolutions.description: Leiden resolutions for composition; one label column per value. cellcharter ignores it.

library_key.description: obs column naming each section or sample; niches are then fitted per library and are not comparable across libraries.

min_niche_size.description: Niches with fewer cells are relabelled not_a_niche; null keeps every niche.

label_key.description: obs column with the cell-type or state label used for neighbour counts.

hops.description: Neighbour hops d aggregated into the profile; 1 uses direct contacts.

scale.description: Z-score each label column before clustering.

abs_nhood.description: Use neighbour counts instead of frequencies; mixes local density into the profile.

n_perms.description: Label permutations for the neighbourhood enrichment z-score.

hops.description: Maximum graph hop D; the embedding has D+1 blocks, each of width n_pca_components or the latent width.

n_clusters.description: Mixture components K; null selects K by BIC over 2 to 20 (proposed rule, tested in B1).

n_pca_components.description: PCA components of layers/log1p_norm when use_rep is null.

use_rep.description: obsm key of a precomputed embedding such as an scVI latent; preferred over PCA.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for mixture initialisation and Leiden; the same seed, inputs and parameters give the same labels.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/niche_label_res0.5. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary: method, n_niches per resolution column, graph sizes; mean_max_probability for cellcharter. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
